messages.start:
👋 DailyLog is ready in English.

Use the buttons for a guided flow:
🍽 Meal → type → details
🏃 Training → activity → end
😴 Sleep → end
📤 Export → format → all data or dates

You can write /help whenever you are not tracking an activity.
messages.help:
How to log your day:

🍽 Add meal → choose the meal type → write food and quantities.
🏃 Start training → choose a suggestion or send any activity name → end it when finished.
😴 Start sleep → end it after waking up.
📤 Export → choose XLSX or PDF → choose all data or a date range.

At any selection step, use ✖ Cancel or /cancel. While a training or sleep session is open, only end or cancel it first.

Quick text entries also work: lunch pasta 120g chicken 200g, tennis 18:00-19:30, sleep 23:30-07:10.
messages.meal_type_prompt: 🍽 Step 1 of 2: choose the meal type.
messages.meal_text_prompt:
🍽 Step 2 of 2: write what you ate for {meal_type}.
Example: pasta 120g chicken 200g
messages.meal_invalid: Choose one of the meal types below, or cancel the flow.
messages.meal_text_invalid: Write the food and quantities for {meal_type}, or cancel the flow.
messages.training_prompt: 🏃 Step 1 of 1: what activity are you starting? Choose one or write your own.
messages.activity_invalid: Write an activity name (up to 120 characters), or cancel the flow.
messages.export_format_prompt: 📤 Step 1 of 3: choose the export format.
messages.export_range_prompt: 📤 Step 2 of 3: export all saved data or a date range?
messages.export_range_invalid: Choose all data or date range below, or cancel the flow.
messages.export_empty: 📭 There are no entries to export for that period.
messages.export_prompt: Use 📤 Export, then choose format and dates.
messages.unknown: I did not understand that. Use a button or /help.
messages.open_only: ⚠️ An activity is open. End or cancel it before using another command.
messages.date_order: The end date must not be before the start date.
messages.edit_empty: No editable fields found. Use label=, text=, start=, end=, kind=.
messages.invalid_entry: ⚠️ That entry could not be saved: {reason}
